Does this patient have hypothyroidism? A systematic review of the diagnostic accuracy of thyroid-stimulating hormone.
result.authorString: Zulewski H, Muller B, Exer P, Miserez AR, Staub JJ.
result.abstractText: BACKGROUND: Hypothyroidism is common and its symptoms are non-specific. OBJECTIVE: To summarise the accuracy of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) and of the classical clinical signs for overt primary hypothyroidism in adults. DATA SYNTHESIS: Across 14 studies of 9 412 unselected adults, a serum TSH above 4.5 mIU/L had a positive likelihood ratio of 3.8 (95% CI 2.1-6.9) and a negative likelihood ratio of 0.21 for overt hypothyroidism. The twelve-sign clinical score performed far worse. CONCLUSION: TSH remains the single most useful first test in primary care.

result.title: Anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies for autoimmune thyroiditis: a meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy.
result.authorString: Pedersen IB, Knudsen N, Jorgensen T.
result.abstractText: CONTEXT: Thyroid peroxidase antibodies (anti-TPO) are used to separate autoimmune from non-autoimmune thyroid failure. OBJECTIVE: To pool the diagnostic accuracy of a positive anti-TPO result against histology or long-term follow-up. RESULTS: Eleven studies with 4 015 participants were pooled. A positive anti-TPO test had a sensitivity of 0.90 and a specificity of 0.80 for autoimmune thyroiditis; heterogeneity was moderate. CONCLUSIONS: Anti-TPO is sensitive but not specific enough to stand alone in a low-prevalence population.

result.title: Cold intolerance as a presenting symptom in primary care: a prospective cohort.
result.abstractText: BACKGROUND: Cold intolerance is a classical symptom of thyroid failure but is rarely quantified. METHODS: We followed 640 adults presenting to 12 general practices and recorded cold intolerance, tiredness and weight change against thyroid function testing at six months. RESULTS: Cold intolerance carried a positive likelihood ratio of 2.1 for a subsequent diagnosis of hypothyroidism. CONCLUSION: The symptom is weakly informative on its own.
